scope: Read-only audit plus real default-generation diagnostic runs; no production source edits, provider calls, model authoring or simulated electrical PASS.

CDCLVC1104.selection: Representative four-output clock-buffer variant chosen for this diagnostic; the supplied PDF also describes six other variants, so CDCLVC11 alone is not an orderable device.

pin_map_source.independent_confirmation: SCAU041 Figure 1 page 3 matches all eight terminals

CDCLVC1104.current_route: No compatible SPICE link found by bounded TI product-page discovery; only supplier IBIS listed on inspected page. Default generated route then refuses missing reviewed pinout profile. Even with a new profile there is no clock-buffer behavioral compiler/test implementation.
CDCLVC1104.required_behavior: Supply-dependent fanout buffer: asynchronous 1G disable forces every output LOW, input/output voltage thresholds, supply/load-dependent output impedance and timing. Tests need all outputs, wrong-state and wrong-delay controls, datasheet load Figure 3 (50 ohm to VDD/2 with 2 pF), page 7 switching bands, page 6 voltage/current bounds. Jitter/temperature/statistical claims remain UNKNOWN until explicitly modeled.

pin_map_source.package_ambiguity: DFN DDB has exposed pad pin 9 grounded; TS8 has no exposed pad. Full ordering code selects physical map and grade.

LTC2452.current_route: Default ADI page fetch recorded HTTPError and continued to generated route, which refuses missing reviewed pinout profile. ADI inspected product page lists documentation/evaluation resources but no SPICE/LTspice download. One same-security-path bounded follow-up fetched HTTP 200 (163073 bytes), a second fetched HTTP 403 Forbidden. No security bypass attempted. Local shipped LTspice lib.zip filename lookup had no LTC2452/CDCLVC match; filename search alone is not proof of global absence.
LTC2452.required_behavior: Reusable ADC sample/conversion/quantization plus serial state-machine blocks: POR ~2.1 V and ~0.5 ms, 13-23 ms conversion window, CONVERT/SLEEP/DATA OUTPUT transitions, binary 16-bit MSB-first code (32768*VIN/VREF+32768) with endpoint saturation, CS/SCK edge behavior/abort/restart/status polling, genuine SDO high impedance, REF/common-mode limits and current modes. Independent benches need page 8 Table 1 code vectors and pages 4/9-12 timing/protocol bands; static pin shell cannot represent conversion.
